content_sections.heading: ECHS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ECHS Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ECHS Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 1 for Officer-in-Charge, 1 for Pharmacist, and 1 for Laboratory Technician.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Officer-in-Charge: Graduate with a minimum of 5 years of work experience in healthcare institutions or managerial positions. Pharmacist: B Pharmacy OR 10+2 with a science stream and an Approved Diploma in Pharmacy, registered under the Pharmacy Act 1948, with a minimum of 3 years of experience. Laboratory Technician: B.Sc. (Medical Lab Technology) OR Matriculation/Higher Secondary/Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science and a Diploma in Medical Lab Technology with a minimum of 3 years of experience as a Lab Assistant.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 65 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules are not specified in the provided data. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ECHS recruitment is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Officer-in-Charge, Pharmacist, and Laboratory Technician in this ECHS recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this ECHS recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this ECHS recruitment is 65 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: For the Pharmacist post, candidates should possess a B Pharmacy degree or have completed 10+2 with a science stream and an approved Diploma in Pharmacy, along with at least 3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Officer-in-Charge position?
faq.answer: The Officer-in-Charge position offers a salary of Rs. 95,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this ECHS recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these ECHS posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these ECHS posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for ECHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.
